Total identified fraudulent exposure amounts to $128.33 USD. The primary flagged transaction 3583227 occurred on 2016-12-29 07:53:54. Activity exhibits unauthorized electronic card-not-present exploitation under pattern classification 'card_not_present_new_device'.

PART III: CHRONOLOGY & TYPOLOGY PATTERN MECHANICS
Initial alert triggered via customer_report ('Customer C08106 message: 'I never made this $128.33 purchase. Please check my card.' Refers to 3583227.'). Velocity analysis revealed 1 transaction(s) within the 1-hour window and 1 within 24 hours (velocity spike ratio: 12.54).

Cardholder was contacted via out-of-band verification and affirmed: 'Cardholder provided response for analyst_info under scenario denies'. Graph traversal confirmed pattern typology 'card_not_present_new_device'. Filing is mandated pursuant to Bank Fraud Policy Section 3a (Confirmed Unauthorized Fraud), Policy Rule R2 (Customer Disavowal), and Policy Rule R6 (Syndicate Multi-Card Compromise).

PART V: ACTIONS TAKEN & RECOMMENDED DISPOSITION
The financial institution has immediately blocked payment card C08106-K1, declined pending authorizations, and placed all connected accounts and shared devices under enhanced automated surveillance. This case is referred to law enforcement and FinCEN for coordinated syndicate interdiction.
